opening.argument: The presentation prominently advertises a “FRONT RUNNING BOT” with “AUTO 10X PROFIT,” while describing automated buying and selling at a profit. It then directs viewers to connect MetaMask to Remix, create and fund the contract with BNB, and pay fees to trigger its action. The description promises that 90% of profit will return to the user's wallet, and the speaker reports roughly 0.3 over about an hour while recommending participation with one BNB. Although the speaker calls the offering free, the promised returns remain tied to viewer-funded contract activity and repeated transaction fees, with the description itself acknowledging that funds can be wasted in fees.
